name: Seddon Village
aboutDesc: Brought to you by Seddon Village Traders Union and operated by shop local experts Why Leave Town, Seddon Village Gift Card is aimed at encouraging people to shop local. Each card that is purchased can only be spent in local participating businesses...meaning all the money stays local!
